The following events took place in '''1800 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*An [[Bombardment of the Uba system|orbital bombardment]] of the planets in the [[Uba system/Legends|Uba system]], a preemptive strike by the Republic to deter the native [[Ubese/Legends|Ubese]] from continuing to build banned weapons, ignites superweapon caches that engulf the planets in radioactive firestorms.<ref name="Alien Anthology">''[[Alien Anthology]]''</ref> The native [[Ubese/Legends|Ubese]] are nearly exterminated by the event,<ref name="Atlas" /> with the only survivors on [[Uba IV/Legends|Uba IV]]; some are relocated to the [[Ubertica system/Legends|Ubertica system]], but the event sparks a deep-seated hatred of the Republic among the Ubese.<ref name="Alien Anthology" />
